input.brand_values: 고객 신뢰와 투명한 정보 제공, 민감한 고객 정보를 보호하는 책임감, 법규 준수와 안전한 품질 관리, 환경 보호와 지속가능한 경영, 과장 없는 정직한 커뮤니케이션
input.product_description: Purezza offers a range of sunscreens that prioritize skin safety and environmental responsibility. Our formulas are free from harsh chemicals, artificial fragrances, and dyes, ensuring gentle protection for sensitive skin. We adhere to strict quality control measures, sourcing ingredients from sustainable suppliers whenever possible. With transparent labeling and honest communication about our products' benefits and limitations, we empower you to make informed choices about your skincare routine.
input.target_group: Skincare-conscious women and men in their 20s with sensitive skin

virtual_customer_feedbacks.persona_profile: 28, environmental scientist, passionate about sustainable living, reads labels carefully, prioritizes natural products
virtual_customer_feedbacks.positive_reaction: I love that Purezza is transparent about their ingredients and sourcing! It's so refreshing to see a brand that truly cares about the environment.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.negative_reaction: I'm disappointed that some of your products still contain some artificial fragrances. Can you please reformulate them?
virtual_customer_feedbacks.improvement_suggestion: Consider using only plant-based ingredients and eliminating all artificial additives.

virtual_customer_feedbacks.persona_profile: 25, student, suffers from eczema, has tried many products for sensitive skin, prioritizes gentle formulas
virtual_customer_feedbacks.positive_reaction: I've been searching for a sunscreen that won't irritate my skin, and Purezza's formula is amazing! It's so gentle and non-irritating.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.negative_reaction: I wish you had more fragrance-free options. Some of your products still have a strong scent that bothers me.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.improvement_suggestion: Offer more fragrance-free options or clearly label which products are suitable for sensitive skin.

virtual_customer_feedbacks.persona_profile: 29, personal trainer, prioritizes natural health and wellness, reads reviews online
virtual_customer_feedbacks.positive_reaction: I appreciate that Purezza is committed to using sustainable suppliers. It's great to see a brand that cares about the environment.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.negative_reaction: Some of your products are a bit pricey for my budget. I wish you had more affordable options without compromising on quality.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.improvement_suggestion: Consider offering more affordable options or loyalty programs to reward repeat customers.

virtual_customer_feedbacks.persona_profile: 26, beauty blogger, has tried many skincare products, prioritizes effective formulas and good packaging
virtual_customer_feedbacks.positive_reaction: I love the minimalist packaging of Purezza's products! It's so chic and Instagram-worthy.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.negative_reaction: Some of your products don't quite live up to their claims. I've had mixed results with the moisturizing properties.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.improvement_suggestion: Improve product efficacy or provide more detailed instructions for use.

virtual_customer_feedbacks.persona_profile: 30, accountant, prioritizes budget-friendly options, reads reviews online
virtual_customer_feedbacks.positive_reaction: I appreciate that Purezza is transparent about their ingredients and pricing. It's refreshing to see a brand that's honest.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.negative_reaction: Some of your products are still a bit pricey for my budget. I wish you had more affordable options or discounts for loyal customers.
virtual_customer_feedbacks.improvement_suggestion: Consider offering loyalty programs, discounts, or bundle deals to make your products more accessible.

marketing_strategy.main_insight: Customers appreciate Purezza's commitment to sustainability and gentle formulas but desire more fragrance-free options, affordability, and improved product efficacy.
selling_points: Gentle formulas suitable for sensitive skin
marketing_strategy.marketing_direction: Focus on highlighting Purezza's commitment to sustainability, transparency, and customer well-being while addressing customer pain points through product development and targeted messaging.
marketing_strategy.message_strategy: Emphasize the benefits of Purezza's natural ingredients and gentle formulas for sensitive skin. Showcase customer testimonials and highlight the brand's sustainable practices. Address concerns about price and product performance with transparent communication and value-driven promotions.
marketing_strategy.recommended_tone: Authentic, informative, and empathetic. Build trust by being transparent about product limitations and actively engaging with customer feedback.

sns_content.main_copy: Say goodbye to harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances! Our sunscreens are carefully crafted for sensitive skin, providing gentle protection without compromising on effectiveness. We believe in honest communication - our labels are transparent, so you know exactly what you're putting on your skin.
sns_content.short_hook: Sensitive skin? We've got you covered!
sns_content.image_prompt_for_sdxl: A clean and modern bathroom counter with a matte-finish sunscreen tube in the center. The tube is a calming shade of blue and has a minimalist design with a subtle texture. Next to it lies a soft, white towel and a pair of sunglasses on a small table. The background is a gentle, gradient sky with a few wispy clouds, evoking a sense of serenity and protection from the sun.
sns_content.negative_prompt_for_sdxl: serum bottle, transparent liquid bottle, perfume bottle, toner bottle, essence bottle, watery cosmetic bottle
